title: Categorical Algebra of Atomic Monoids: Presentability, Regularity, and Pretorsion Theories
summary: We study the category $\mathsf{AtoMon}$ of atomic monoids and atom-preserving homomorphisms. We prove that $\mathsf{AtoMon}$ is locally finitely presentable by exhibiting a strong generator consisting of compact objects. We show that $\mathsf{AtoMon}$ admits (regular epi, mono)-factorizations but that it is not a regular category: we construct a regular epimorphism which is not pullback-stable.
